content.value: A coal fired steam boiler plant consumes 500kg of coal per hour. The boiler evaporates 4 ton of water at 42ºC into superheated steam at a pressure of 13 bar and 295°C. If the calorific value of fuel is 32500 kJ/kg of coal, determine-(i) Equivalent evaporation from and at 100°C; and (ii) Thermal efficiency of the steam boiler. Assume specific heat of superheated steam is 2.1 kJ/kg.K.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
